paragraphs: Kids Sleep Gummies are a great-tasting way to help promote restful sleep and bring bliss back to bedtime.

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: Following recommended usage guide, take 30-60 minutes before bedtime. Ensure each gummy is thoroughly chewed before swallowing. For short term use only. Consult pediatrician before use.

blocks.label: Other ingredients
paragraphs: Organic tapioca syrup, raw cane sugar, water; less than 2% of: citric acid, coconut oil & carnauba wax, fruit juice (for color), natural flavor, pectin, sodium citrate.
Free of the top 9 Allergens: Peanuts, wheat, eggs, milk, fish, shellfish, tree nuts, soy, sesame.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Keep out of reach of children. Take only as directed. Do not use if safety seal is broken. Not recommended for children under 3 years of age. Melatonin may cause drowsiness, do not operate machinery, or drive a vehicle after taking.
Store in a cool, dry place.
